The Shootout

Tucson, AZ · University of Arizona · Road

The Shootout is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from University Blvd & Euclid Ave. About 70 miles, a 22–28+ mph; Scootout 19–23 mph; Old-Old Man 16–20 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–23 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Shootout group ride

Tucson's famous fast Saturday road ride. Three groups leave a few minutes apart on the same route south of town. It is self-supported and riders separate by pace. Not a beginner ride. The 16–20 mph group is the friendliest option.
